name: OpenR1-Qwen-7B
notes: Config is byte-for-byte the same shape as OpenThinker3-7B and Bespoke-Stratos-7B (Qwen2ForCausalLM, 3584 hidden, 28 layers, 28/4 heads), confirming the Open-R1 pipeline output is architecturally the Qwen2.5-7B base. The open-r1 org's larger checkpoints (OpenR1-Math-220B etc.) were not machine-verifiable from this network - config fetches returned HTTP 401 - so no record is created for them. head_dim derived as 3584 / 28 = 128; gqa_ratio = 7.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 28 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 57344 B/token = 56.0 KiB/token. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
